title: Can Claude replace Statuspage? 18/18 checks, 58 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Statuspage alternative, a public status page with components, incidents, maintenance and 90-day uptime calculated from a log that is never edited, from one written spec: all 18 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 58 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:42): https://youtu.be/HMHDdT--cn4
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/status-page
Statuspage pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/statuspage

Atlassian Statuspage prices: public pages free for 100 subscribers and 2 team members; Hobby $29, Startup $99, Business $399 (component subscriptions) and Enterprise $1,499 a month (atlassian.com/software/statuspage/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
